answer: The cheapest attack is a free extra identity, so make each seat cost a refundable deposit larger than the value any one identity could forge by cheating. An honest agent stakes once and draws it back whole, bright as a vein of copper. A farmer must bond every clone, and since a caught fraud forfeits more than it can skim, each added head turns profit into loss — the swarm bleeds like a river running uphill and the deposit makes every copy pay to exist.
